top_story.headline: Seven large negative transactions surface, including $51,652.89 charged back to Emmer Majority Builders
top_story.dek: No new RFAIs or Form 99 filings appeared in this edition's window, so voided and negative transactions are the only new FEC items.
paragraphs: The largest is a $51,652.89 negative Schedule A entry for Emmer Majority Builders tied to Edward E. Martin Jr., dated 07/07/2026 and described as a 2026 aggregate earmarked by WinRed that was charged back. A large negative amount is FEC's convention for a voided, reversed or refunded transaction, and it is often mundane.

The Texas Democratic Party shows three negative entries labeled excessive contribution transfers: $27,500 for Stacy Schusterman, $27,500 for Lynn Schusterman and $15,000 for Susan C. Young, all dated 09/02 to 09/03/2026. Trump 47 Committee, Inc. shows two $22,500 negative earmarked contributions for Lewis S. Pemberton and Tricia Pemberton on 09/25/2026.

sections.headline: Seven negative entries of $10,000 or more, from a chargeback to excessive-contribution transfers
paragraphs: Seven new rows carry large negative amounts, which by FEC convention mark a voided, reversed or refunded transaction. Most look routine, such as excessive-contribution corrections and earmark reversals.

items: Emmer Majority Builders had a $51,652.89 contribution from Edward E. Martin Jr. charged back. The 07/07/2026 entry is described as a 2026 aggregate earmarked by WinRed. (Filing)
Texas Democratic Party reversed a $27,500 contribution from Stacy Schusterman as an excessive contribution transfer. The entry is dated 09/02/2026. (Filing)
Texas Democratic Party reversed a $27,500 contribution from Lynn Schusterman as an excessive contribution transfer. The entry is dated 09/03/2026. (Filing)
Texas Democratic Party reversed a $15,000 contribution from Susan C. Young as an excessive contribution transfer. The entry is dated 09/03/2026. (Filing)
Kentucky State Democratic Central Executive Committee shows a $10,000 contribution from William P. Butler reversed. The entry is dated 09/14/2026. (Filing)
Trump 47 Committee, Inc. reversed a $22,500 earmarked contribution from Lewis S. Pemberton. The entry is dated 09/25/2026. (Filing)
Trump 47 Committee, Inc. reversed a $22,500 earmarked contribution from Tricia Pemberton. The entry is dated 09/25/2026. (Filing)

footer.coverage_window: FEC filings received 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-04 (PM edition). 74 filings in the window were all reported in prior editions.
